p: Fouling on the compressor blades costs output and heat rate, more in dust and damp air. The online wash at load removes only part of it; the offline wash, with the rotor cranked cold, the rest.
Air-operated valves (the auxiliary boiler's burner, the control valves) need 4 bar to move.
